en: The image shows a black-and-white, panoramic view of a riverside or lakeside town surrounded by forests and hills. In the foreground, there are leafy trees and rooftops of small houses. A prominent feature is a tall, white church with a steeple located near the water's edge. The body of water is wide, with more forested hills visible in the background. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and rural, without any modern elements.
